patch.title: platform/x86: oxpec: Add OneXPlayer 3 quirk
patch.author: Antheas Kapenekakis
patch.scope: Exact ONEXPLAYER 3 DMI quirk only; no EC policy changes

hardware_validation: Matching signed module, persistent provider and native Steam ceiling API tested. The separate bypass interface and Decky plugin are installed; live Decky reads, invalid-request rejection and an unchanged awake-mode selection passed. Upgrade retained the owner's current 100% ceiling and inhibit-charge-awake mode. Steam reports a 50–100% ceiling range. Physical charging, resume and reboot remain separate checks.

decky.name: OXP3 Charge Controls
decky.scope: Independent explicit charge-behaviour selection; charge ceiling is read-only
